systems.name: 1.1 New Sector Thematics
systems.notes: Add 3 new sectors: Sewer Tunnels (toxic puddles, pipe clumps), Furnace (moving pistons, heat vents), and Containment Vault (holding cells, energy barriers). Each with unique floor tiles, props, and ambient effects.
tasks: Design tile sheets and wall sets for each sector
Create sector-specific decorative props (pipes, vents, cells)
Implement environmental hazards (toxic damage, piston crush, energy burst)
Integrate into procedural room generator with spawn weights

systems.name: 1.2 Boss Variety & Loop Modifiers
systems.notes: Expand beyond THE PRODUCER. Add 3 new bosses: THE MAW (bio-lab horror, tentacle swipes), THE FURNACE KING (fire-based arena control), and THE OVERSEER (rifting void entity with teleporting adds). Each boss appears based on current sector or loop modifier.
tasks: Boss AI, attack patterns, and phase transitions
Boss-specific arena setpieces and camera effects
Loop mutations that change boss spawn behavior
Defeat rewards (unique powerup or weapon skin)

systems.name: 1.3 Setpiece & Room Variety
systems.notes: Increase room setpiece variety per theme. Add conveyor belts, crusher traps, healing stations, and arena control panels that temporarily modify the room (lower walls, activate turrets).
tasks: Design 6 new setpiece types with gameplay impact
Crusher trap timing and visual warning
Turret spawner that allies with player for a wave
